tools.name: find_nodes
tools.description: Search for symbol nodes in the code knowledge graph. Supports filtering by name (substring), kind, language, file path (fuzzy), or qualified name. Returns a list of nodes with their IDs — save IDs for follow-up queries.

filter.description: Filter criteria. All fields are optional and ANDed together.

name.description: Substring match on symbol name. E.g. 'parse_file' matches 'parse_file_incremental'.

kind.description: Symbol kind. One of: function, method, class, struct, enum, trait, interface, module, field, constant, type_alias, namespace, enum_variant

language.description: Source language. One of: Rust, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Go, C, Cpp, CSharp, Kotlin, Scala, Swift, PHP, Vue

file_path_contains.description: Fuzzy match on file path substring. E.g. 'indexer/parse' matches 'crates/core/src/indexer/parse.rs'.

qualified_name.description: Exact qualified name (module::path::symbol). Use for precise lookup.

limit.description: Max results to return. Default: 20. Increase to 50+ for broader exploration.

change_statuses.description: Filter by change status (requires --diff-base index). Use ['add','change'] to list changed symbols. E.g. changed functions: {"change_statuses": ["add","change"], "kinds": ["function","method"]}

tools.name: node_by_id
tools.description: Fetch a single symbol node by its UUID, with its node_tags auto-joined (empty array if the repo has no tags). Use when you already have an ID from a previous result and need fresh metadata (name, kind, file, lines, tags).

id.description: Node UUID obtained from a previous find_nodes / node_edges / graph_reach call.

tools.name: node_edges
tools.description: Get all edges incident to a node: calls, extends, implements, overrides, uses, tests. Use direction='out' to see dependencies; direction='in' to find callers/users.

direction.description: 'out' = what this node calls/extends/uses; 'in' = who calls/extends/uses this node; 'both' = all edges.

tools.name: graph_reach
tools.description: Multi-hop BFS traversal from a start node. Returns nodes reachable within max_depth hops, organized by depth layer. Useful for understanding a component's full dependency fan-out or transitive callers.

direction.description: 'out' = follow outgoing edges (dependencies); 'in' = follow incoming edges (callers); 'both' = bidirectional.

max_depth.description: Maximum number of hops. Recommended: 2-3 for exploration, up to 6 for deep traces. Large values may return many nodes.

edge_kinds.description: Restrict traversal to these edge kinds. Empty array = all kinds.

tools.name: shortest_path
tools.description: Find the shortest path between two nodes in the call/dependency graph. Returns the intermediate nodes and edges. Result hops=-1 means no path found within max_depth.

direction.description: 'out' = follow call direction from→to; 'in' = reverse; 'both' = any direction.

max_depth.description: Maximum path length to search. Default 6. Increase if hops=-1.

tools.name: node_source
tools.description: Get the full source code body of a symbol node. Returns the exact lines from the file where the symbol is defined.

tools.name: source_at
tools.description: Read a slice of source lines from a file by line range (0-based). Use when you have a file path and line numbers but no node ID. Useful for reading context around a symbol.

end_line.description: Last line to return (0-based, inclusive). Keep range under 200 lines for performance.

tools.name: file_source
tools.description: Restore the full source of an entire file from the DB. Use sparingly — prefer source_at with a specific range.

tools.name: file_nodes
tools.description: Get all symbol nodes defined in a specific file, ordered by source position (node_idx). Useful as a table-of-contents for a file.

tools.name: file_imports
tools.description: Get file-level import/dependency edges. 'outgoing' = what this file imports; 'incoming' = which files import this file.

direction.description: 'outgoing' (default) = dependencies of this file; 'incoming' = files that depend on this file.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files in the repository with optional filters. Returns file metadata including language, node count, and source classification.

file_source.description: Filter by source classification: local, test, generated, minified, stub

change_statuses.description: Filter by change status (requires --diff-base index). ['add','change'] lists changed files.

tools.name: repo_summary
tools.description: Get repository overview statistics: total files, total symbol nodes, total edges, language distribution, source classification breakdown.

tools.name: list_repos
tools.description: List all indexed repositories/branches with unified repo identifiers. Each row's repo_id is '{domain}/{org}/{repo}@{branch}' (e.g. 'github.com/org/repo@main') — copy it for any CLI command's repo argument. Also returns per-branch stats (nodes_total, files_total, branch, indexed_at, db_path, branch_slug). Note: agent tool calls operate on the session's bound repo; use this to help the user discover what has been indexed (or run `codexqa repos` in a terminal).

tools.name: find_nodes_by_tag
tools.description: Find symbol nodes by semantic tag key/value pairs. Tags encode metadata like visibility, async, abstract, etc. Useful for questions like 'find all public async functions'.

value.description: Tag value. E.g. for key='visibility': 'public', 'private', 'protected'. Optional — omit to match any value for the key.

language.description: Restrict to a specific language. Optional.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: BM25 full-text search over indexed source code. Use when you don't know the exact symbol name: search by keywords, identifiers, error messages, or string literals appearing in code. Returns matching file paths with BM25 scores and snippets. Handles camelCase (partial words match: 'SearchResult' finds 'Bm25SearchResult') and Chinese comments. Combine with find_nodes/file_nodes to resolve hits to symbol nodes, or source_at to read more context. AVAILABILITY: requires `codexqa bm25 <repo>` to have been run once — if this tool is not in your tool list, the repo has no BM25 index; if a call returns an error about BM25 not enabled, tell the user to run `codexqa bm25 <repo>` and meanwhile fall back to find_nodes (name search) or list_files + source_at.

query.description: Search query: space-separated keywords. Rare identifiers rank highest (BM25 IDF). E.g. 'verify_jwt', 'TokenExpired retry', 'fn open'.

test_filter.description: Test-file filtering. 'exclude' (default) skips test files (fixtures, *_test.*, spec files); 'include' searches everything; 'only' restricts to test files only (useful for 'which tests cover this').

tools.name: search_wiki
tools.description: Semantic (vector) search over an architecture wiki. Wiki generation is temporarily unavailable — do not run `codexqa wiki` or `wiki embed`. If this tool errors with 'not enabled', fall back to search_code (BM25) or find_nodes. When a wiki already exists, returns sections ranked by similarity, each with section text, title path, and refs (source path + line range). Follow refs with source_at.

query.description: Natural-language query, e.g. '重试逻辑在哪里处理' / 'where is retry logic handled'. Works best with domain/module terms; purely abstract questions may drift.

tools.name: symbol_diff
tools.description: Render the unified diff of a changed symbol (function/method/class) against the diff-base. Requires the repo to be indexed with --diff-base. Use find_nodes with change_statuses=['add','change'] to get changed symbols and their IDs first, then call this per symbol. Output: unified diff text ('-' old lines, '+' new lines, '@@' hunk headers) plus diff_lines (true total) and truncated flag. Truncation keeps head+tail and marks the omitted middle with '... [truncated N lines]'.

id.description: Node UUID of the changed symbol (from find_nodes with change_statuses filter)

max_lines.description: Max rendered diff lines. Default 100, hard cap 500. Truncation keeps head 75% + tail 25% with a marker in between.

tools.name: change_groups
tools.description: Get the change topology: changed symbols (add/change vs diff-base) grouped by graph relations (same file / calls / file imports) into change groups. ONE call returns the full grouping — groups ordered by max fan-in (highest risk first), each group with its symbols (id/name/kind/file:line/change_status/fan-in/fan-out), files, and grouping signals, plus inter-group call edges. Use this FIRST for change review: it gives the structural map so you can budget deep-dives per group instead of querying per symbol. Requires --diff-base index; empty groups = no changes or not a diff index. Response carries `truncated: true` when symbol/edge collection hit hard limits (5000 symbols / 100k edges) — treat the topology as incomplete and say so in the report.
